Image2 is design reference only, not a pasted logo. Preserve its recognizable angular interlocked upper arms and long central downward point, the true Freljord silhouette; NOT a snowflake, triquetra, Demacian wings or invented royal crown. On wooden panel use aged pale-gold/brown carved relief against dark wood. On any existing cloth preserve cloth folds and use muted aged gold thread. Fit within existing panel or existing banner without enlarging. Do not add new banners or remove buildings. No text or other changes. Original Heroes of Might and Magic III compatible richly textured painted 2D building appearance, restrained highlights, native-scale readability. No Blender or equivalent 3D rendering, no shiny modern CGI, no flat vector sticker, no neon or splash-art aesthetic. This is a local crest repair and must preserve building geometry.
